title: Professional and accommodating receptionists.
content: I must admit after the practice yesterday with my partner, I couldn't fault both receptionists on the front counter, they were friendly, efficient and very professional in their approach. Well Done both of you! Majority of medical practices at the moment don't have a very good name but I think you counter balance the good with the bad. x
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
